# French Database

All versions: [10.5281/zenodo.14541426](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14541426) (this DOI always points to the latest version).

## Unreleased

These corrections will be included in the next version of the database on Zenodo.

- **Institution of defence for theses.fr theses.** The columns `institution_thesis_name` and `institution_thesis_id` of `thesis_metadata` were empty for the 12,191 theses coming from theses.fr. They are now filled.
- **Harmonised roles in `thesis_edge`.** The roles of theses.fr were spelled differently from those of Sudoc: `institution_defense` is now `institution_defence`, and `doctoral_schools` is now `doctoral_school`, as for Sudoc data.
- **Stable temporary identifiers.** The temporary identifiers of theses, individuals and institutions without official identifiers (`temp_sudoc_*`, `temp_thesefr_*`) were random numbers, regenerated each time the database was built. They are now built from the record itself (format `temp_X_Y_<hash>`), so that they stay the same from one version to the next. All temporary identifiers change once in this version.
- **Duplicated research partners.** 97 duplicated links between theses.fr theses and research partners, and one empty institution, are removed from `thesis_edge`, `thesis_edge_complete_data` and `thesis_institution`.

[10.5281/zenodo.15270248](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15270248)
